properties.NAME: WEST HAWAII (ext)
properties.CHANGE: WEST HAWAII (extinct) created by the Territory of Hawaii from the districts of Kau, N. Kohala, S. Kohala, N. Kona and S. Kona on the island of Hawaii, all other islands within three nautical miles of the shores thereof and the waters adjacent thereto.
properties.CITATION: (Hawaii Terr. Laws 1903, reg. sess., act 31, ch. 1/p. 42)
